property_summary: A caller that is not the owner and not approved should always cause approvedToLog to return false.

After any sequence of calls that only the owner can call setApprovedLogger, the approvedLoggers mapping should return true for any address that was previously approved by the owner, but the buggy version never updates the mapping.
After a call to setApprovedLogger, the mapping approvedLoggers should reflect the new status for the updated address.
After any sequence of calls, the value of approvedLoggers for any address matches the last status set for that address by setApprovedLogger.
After a call to setApprovedLogger, the return value of approvedToLog for the same logger address equals the status passed to setApprovedLogger.
After any call to setApprovedLogger, calling approvedToLog(logger) returns the status that was last stored for that logger.
After calling setApprovedLogger with a status, approvedToLog always returns that same status.
If setApprovedLogger is called twice for the same address with status true and then false, the final approvedToLog returns false.
When logCreated returns true, the caller must be an approved logger; specifically, the return value of logCreated is false if the caller is not approved, and true only if the caller is approved.
The function logCreated returns true if and only if the caller is an approved logger.
For any caller, calling logCreated returns the same value as calling approvedToLog with the same caller.
The return value of logCreated must be true for any approved caller.
Calling logCreated by an approved logger returns true.
Approved loggers can emit events and get true return; unapproved loggers get false return.
For any caller, approvedToLog(caller) returns true if and only if logCreated returns true.
If a caller is not approved, logCreated should return false.
For any call to logCreated, the return value must match the result of approvedToLog(msg.sender).
For any approved logger, calling logCreated always returns true.
The return value of logCreated is always false unless the caller is an approved logger.
For any caller, calling logRedemptionRequested returns true if and only if approvedToLog(caller) is true.
logRedemptionRequested returns true if and only if the caller is approved to log.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested must be true when the caller is approved to log.
For callee with approved logger status, logRedemptionRequested returns the same value as approvedToLog(callee).
The return value of logRedemptionRequested must equal the result of approvedToLog for the same caller.
When the caller is approved, logRedemptionRequested returns true, and when not approved, it returns false.
For any caller, the return value of logRedemptionRequested matches the value of approvedToLog(caller).
When logRedemptionRequested is called by an approved logger, it should return true, not false.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested should be true when the caller is an approved logger.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested equals the approval status of the caller (true if approved, false if not).
The return value of logRedemptionRequested must equal the negation of the caller's approval status.
logRedemptionRequested returns the original approval status of the caller, not its negation.
When msg.sender is an approved logger, logGotRedemptionSignature must return true.
When msg.sender is NOT an approved logger, logGotRedemptionSignature must return false.
The return value of logGotRedemptionSignature must equal approvedToLog(msg.sender).
The return value of logGotRedemptionSignature must equal approvedToLog(msg.sender) when the function does not revert.
If logGotRedemptionSignature succeeds (returns true), then the caller remains approved to log afterward.
For any caller that is not approved, logGotRedemptionSignature must return false (not revert).
For approved callers, logGotRedemptionSignature must not revert and must return true.
For any caller, the return value of logGotRedemptionSignature must equal the caller's approval status.
For any caller, logGotRedemptionSignature should revert if and only if the caller is not approved.
For any caller, calling logGotRedemptionSignature with any arguments returns true if and only if the caller is approved.
For a caller not approved as a logger, logGotRedemptionSignature returns false
The return value of logRegisteredPubkey matches approvedToLog(msg.sender) (i.e., false when not approved, true when approved).
For approved loggers, logRegisteredPubkey must return true and emit RegisteredPubkey, but the mutant returns false and does not emit.
If the caller is an approved logger, then logRegisteredPubkey returns true; if not, it returns false.
logRegisteredPubkey returns true if and only if the caller is an approved logger.
For any approved logger call to logRegisteredPubkey, the return value is always true.
If a call to logRegisteredPubkey returns false, msg.sender is not an approved logger.
For an address that is an approved logger, calling logRegisteredPubkey returns true.
For any caller that is an approved logger, calling logRegisteredPubkey returns true.
For any address that is not an approved logger, calling logRegisteredPubkey returns false.
For any caller, the return value of logSetupFailed() equals true (success) if and only if the caller is approved.
For any caller, calling logSetupFailed() returns false exactly when the caller is not approved.
For any approved logger, calling logSetupFailed() returns true.
For any caller that is approved to log, logSetupFailed() should return true.
If a caller is approved to log, logSetupFailed() returns true; if not approved, it returns false.
For any address, the return value of logSetupFailed() when called by that address equals the approved status of that address.
When approvedToLog(msg.sender) is true, logSetupFailed() returns true; when false, returns false.
The return value of logSetupFailed() is always true.
A call to logSetupFailed() returns true exactly if the caller is an approved logger.
The value of approvedToLog(msg.sender) remains unchanged after calling logSetupFailed().
The event log SetupFailed is emitted after calling logSetupFailed()
Calling logSetupFailed() does not change the return value of approvedToLog(msg.sender).
For any caller, if they are approved to log, then calling logFunded should return true.
For any caller, calling logFunded always returns true when the caller is approved.
Calling logFunded() returns the same value as approvedToLog(msg.sender).
For any caller, logFunded() returns true if and only if the caller is approved to log.

For any call to logFunded, when the result is true, then the caller is approved to log; and when the caller is approved, logFunded returns true exactly once per call (i.e., the return value is exactly approvedToLog(msg.sender)).
For any caller, logFunded returns true if and only if the caller is approved.
logFunded returns true if and only if the caller is NOT approved.
For any caller, logFunded does not revert for approved callers and the return value matches the approval status after the call.
For any caller, logFunded returns false if and only if the caller is approved.
After calling logFunded() from a given caller, the emit of Funded matches the caller's approval status recorded before the call.
logCourtesyCalled returns true when called by an approved logger.
logCourtesyCalled returns true when called by an approved logger.
The return value of logCourtesyCalled equals the result of approvedToLog(msg.sender) when approvedToLog returns true.
When logCourtesyCalled is called by a caller who is approved to log, the function must return true
When logCourtesyCalled is called by an approved logger, the return value is the same as approvedToLog(msg.sender).
logCourtesyCalled returns true if and only if the caller is an approved logger.
logCourtesyCalled always returns the same value as logSetupFailed when called with the same caller.
logCourtesyCalled returns true when called by an approved logger, and false when called by a non-approved logger.
logCourtesyCalled returns true if and only if logFunded returns true when called by the same caller.
logCourtesyCalled returns true if the caller is an approved logger and the event is emitted; otherwise, it returns false. The bug flips the true return to false.
For any caller, logStartedLiquidation returns true if and only if the caller is approved to log.
logStartedLiquidation returns true when called by an approved logger.
logStartedLiquidation returns true exactly when called by an approved logger.
logStartedLiquidation returns false when called by an approved logger.
logStartedLiquidation returns false when called by an unapproved logger.
Calling logStartedLiquidation returns true when the caller is a logger with approved status true.
